annotations.description: Maximum health points; used to normalise health bars in the HUD.

Floating-point timestamp of the most-recent physics simulation step; used by the client for position interpolation.
Team number: 0 = Unassigned, 1 = Spectator, 2 = Terrorist, 3 = Counter-Terrorist.
Server tick on which the entity's Think() function will next execute (-1 = never).
Entity flags bitmask (FL_ONGROUND = 1, FL_DUCKING = 4, FL_INWATER = 8, FL_FROZEN = 0x200, etc.).
Current world-space velocity vector of the entity.
Additional world-space velocity contributed by moving platforms, conveyor belts, etc.
CHandle to the entity that owns or spawned this entity (e.g. the thrower of a grenade).
Effect flags bitmask (EF_NODRAW = 32, EF_NORECEIVESHADOW = 64, etc.).
CHandle to the entity this entity is standing on (INVALID_EHANDLE if airborne).
Surface friction multiplier (1.0 = normal; lower values make the entity slide more).
Gravity scale multiplier (1.0 = normal; 0 = no gravity).
Time-scale multiplier applied to this entity's simulation (1.0 = real time; used by bullet time effects).
True when the entity's animation must be updated every server tick regardless of network interest.
Root entity class in Source 2 from which all server-side entities derive. Provides health, team, physics, timing, and transmit state.
RenderMode_t enum controlling transparency and rendering method (0 = Normal, 5 = Translucent, etc.).
RenderFx_t enum for special rendering effects (pulsing, fading, hologram, etc.).
RGBA tint colour multiplied onto the entity's diffuse texture.
CCollisionProperty struct encoding the entity's collision bounding box shape and flags.
CGlowProperty struct controlling the entity's glow outline (colour, radius, visibility rules).
Multiplier for the glow effect on back-facing surfaces of the model.
Minimum distance (world units) at which the entity starts to fade out.
Distance at which the entity is fully faded out and invisible.

Opacity of this entity's cast shadow (0 = no shadow, 1 = full shadow).
Offset from the entity origin to the player's view position (eye height).

Weapon-handling component (active weapon, switch timing).

Pointer to CCSPlayer_ActionTrackingServices which tracks weapon purchases and rescue state for stats/scoring.
True when the equipped agent skin uses a female voice pack.
Human-readable area/landmark name from the nav mesh where the player was last located (e.g. 'CTSpawn', 'BombsiteA').
True while the player is standing inside a buy zone.

Eye angles at the moment of death, used to pose the ragdoll's head correctly.

Custom viewmodel Y offset in world units (cl_viewmodel_offset_y).
Custom viewmodel Z offset in world units (cl_viewmodel_offset_z).
Custom viewmodel FOV in degrees (cl_viewmodel_fov; clamped to 60–68).
True while the player is in walk mode (shift-walk / cl_showpos = 1 walking).
Entity index of the player or entity that last killed this pawn.
EntitySpottedState_t struct tracking which players have spotted (ESP-radar dot) this entity.

annotations.notes: Only sent to the owning player (LocalPlayerExclusive).

annotations.description: Multiplicative speed modifier applied on top of base movement speed (0.0–1.0 typically; reduced while injured or tased).
True when the weapon's fire input must be fully released before the next shot is accepted (prevents auto-fire on re-deploy).
True if the killing blow on this player was a headshot.
Current armor HP (0–100). Combined-arms note: vest+helmet does not exceed 100 armor points.
Total buy value (in dollars) of equipment currently held by the player.
Equipment value at the start of the current round (after freeze-time buy phase ends).
Equipment value at the moment freeze time ended.
Array of 5 item-definition indices for the agent patch slots (team patches worn on the uniform).
Color applied to the player model while gun-game immunity is active.
GameTime until which the player is immune to damage in Gun Game / Arms Race mode.
True while the player has gun-game spawn immunity (brief invincibility after spawning in Arms Race mode).
GameTime at which molotov/incendiary damage will next be applied to this player.
Server-authoritative eye angles (pitch, yaw, roll) used for hit-box calculation and third-person rendering.
annotations.notes: Encoded at full qangle_precise precision. The definitive source for a player's look direction.

annotations.description: The physical in-world representation of a CS2 player.  Carries per-round state: health, armor, position, animations, and weapon inventory.  A new CCSPlayerPawn is created each round on (re)spawn; the corresponding CCSPlayerController persists across rounds.
annotations.notes: Source 2 architecture separates the controller (session/connection state) from the pawn (physics/animation state).  Demo parsers must follow m_hController → CCSPlayerController to resolve name, team, and stats.

annotations.description: Pointer to CCSPlayer_PingServices managing the in-game map-ping system.
CSPlayerState enum: STATE_ACTIVE = 0 (alive), STATE_WELCOME = 1, STATE_PICKINGTEAM = 2, STATE_PICKINGCLASS = 3, STATE_DEATH_ANIM = 4, STATE_DEATH_WAIT_FOR_KEY = 5, STATE_OBSERVER_MODE = 6.
True once the player moves after spawning; prevents accidental movement-triggered events.
Total duration in seconds of the current flash-bang blind effect (0 when not flashed).
Peak screen-overlay alpha (0–255) of the current flash bang; scales with proximity and facing angle.
GameTime at which the current progress bar (defuse/pickup) started.
Duration in seconds of the current progress bar interaction.
CHandle back to the CCSPlayerController that owns this pawn, even when a bot has taken over.
annotations.notes: Use this to map a pawn to its player for demo parsing.
